pattern: からと言って（からといって）
purpose: Reject an inference that a stated fact might invite.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Plain clause + からと言って
A high price does not necessarily mean something will last.
Failing once is no reason to give up.
Being close does not mean you can say anything you like.
formation: Plain clause + からと言って
restrictions: Commonly followed by a negative or limited conclusion.
mistake: The premise may be true; it is the automatic conclusion that is rejected.
